description: Na₃W₂Ag₃(OF)₆ crystallizes in the trigonal R̅3 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six equivalent F atoms. There are three shorter (2.34 Å) and three longer (2.56 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six equivalent F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₃F₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 36°. All Na-F bond lengths are 2.34 Å. W is bonded to three equivalent O and three equivalent F atoms to form distorted WO₃F₃ octahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and corners with three equivalent AgO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-38°. All W-O bond lengths are 1.82 Å. All W-F bond lengths are 2.10 Å. There are two inequivalent Ag sites. In the first Ag site, Ag is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form AgO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent WO₃F₃ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 38°. All Ag-O bond lengths are 2.49 Å. In the second Ag site, Ag is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three equivalent O atoms. All Ag-O bond lengths are 2.30 Å. O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one W and two Ag atoms. F is bonded to three Na and one W atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing FNa₃W trigonal pyramids.
